script:
I tried explaining Blockbuster to my nephew.
He asked if it was a Marvel movie.
I said no, it's where we went to pay late fees for fun.

My grandson says everything is giving main character energy.
I told him I've been the main character since Happy Days.
He asked if Happy Days was a TikTok trend.

Sade and Kunle fell in love over a shared hatred of Monopoly.
Their first date was a Lionel Richie cover band.
To a marriage with fewer plot twists than Squid Game.

Maria runs our team like Ted Lasso: kind, a little chaotic, always biscuits.
She's leaving us for a job that sounds like an episode of Succession.
Maria, we'll miss you more than the old Netflix password.

Coffee strong enough to get you through a Lord of the Rings marathon.
Smoother than a Bruno Mars bridge.
Open late, like your favourite Twitch streamer.

This minivan has more storage than Mary Poppins' bag.
The sound system makes Hamilton sound live.
And the cup holders fit your Stanley tumbler.

Shipping software used to feel like Jurassic Park: big, loud, and something always escaped.
Now it feels like Formula 1: fast, planned, and every second counts.

Our data strategy was a Rubik's Cube.
Now it's a Duolingo streak: small daily wins.
And our roadmap is less Lost, more Breaking Bad: every episode moves the plot.

Supply and demand is why Taylor Swift tickets cost what they cost.
Opportunity cost is choosing between Elden Ring and sleep.
Inflation is why a Big Mac isn't the same price as when your parents were in school.

Think of a password manager like the Rolodex on your desk.
Phishing is the email version of a Nigerian prince letter.
Two-factor is like needing both keys in Mission: Impossible.

Lagos traffic is so slow I finished a whole season of Big Brother Naija at one roundabout.
My mum still sends voice notes longer than an Avengers movie.
And my landlord raises rent like he's dropping a Davido album.

Sunday brunch with a soundtrack from Outkast to Gladys Knight.
Mimosas strong enough for a Real Housewives reunion.
Portions bigger than a Tyler Perry movie marathon.
